$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for invoice-codeset-match (ebilling-r1 task 054, FR-22, D-93). The Action is a Linear AI Consumer reached only through IInvoiceAi.MatchCodeSetAsync (the Binding carries no tool description, so it is never loop-projected); the schema documents the operand the facade sends as the '## Input' section ({ reference, candidates, examples }) and is validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests like every other mirror. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (use the object-level required array). actionCode carries NO version suffix. The tenant id travels in the LinearRunContext, never in the operand. Deployed to the row by scripts/ebilling/Ensure-ActionRow.ps1.

reference.description: The matter type or practice area to map.

candidates.description: The closed list of code sets the answer must come from: every usable set when there are few, otherwise the top-ranked by embedding similarity. A usable set is active and has at least one active Task code, so the shared Activity and Expense sets are never candidates.

codeSetId.description: The sprk_billingcodesetid; the answer copies it exactly.

description.description: sprk_description: the work the set's task codes cover (admin-editable tuning text).

matchHints.description: sprk_matchhints: matter types and practice areas the set fits, synonyms, and what it is not for (admin-editable tuning text).

taskCodes.description: The set's active Task codes as 'code short-name' strings.

examples.description: Mappings an administrator confirmed in this environment (never from another tenant or environment); empty when there are none.

codeSetName.description: The name of the code set it is mapped to.
